purpose: Production briefs for original editorial artwork; not historical evidence
review: All accepted sheets visually reviewed, full faces/hands/props kept. Sheets2/3 were regenerated to taller compositions before use.

scenes1.png.brief: 1932 Western Australian wheat country, four portrait panels: emu foreground and three men/two guns; farmer lifting ruined wheat; farmers explaining problem at gate; three men unloading period truck. Photorealistic warm light, no text or injury.

scenes2.png.brief: Four tall panels: whole emu; flock approaching water and concealed soldiers; confused soldier with idle jammed Lewis gun; frustrated officer. Recompose earlier near-square draft to1024x1536, preserving hands, faces and period.

scenes3.png.brief: Four tall panels: soldiers mounting gun on1930s truck; running healthy emus; weary farmer still facing birds; unbothered emu close portrait. Recompose earlier near-square draft to1024x1536. No text, injuries or modern props.

truck_reaction.png.brief: Single portrait: seated khaki soldier gripping wooden truck bench with uncomfortable dry-comedy reaction, idle mounted weapon beside him, healthy emu in background, complete face/hat/hands, no firing or injury.
